name: Tendai Odinga-Pathak
role: Network intrusion and digital warfare specialist — netrunner
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Western and Chicago Ave
description:
Djeneba Park-Traore is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 40, he has the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would  — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He taught himself the trade through trial, error, and a pain tolerance that concerns the people who know him best. He works as a netrunner out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Djeneba Park-Traore operates in a narrow band between competence and recklessness that makes fixers nervous and clients satisfied.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Betrayal by someone they trust — the only currency that matters
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Maintains weapons obsessively — cleaning guns is meditation
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
psychology.secret: Djeneba Park-Traore murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "Every system has a door. Most of them have a door the architect forgot about."
"I don't hack networks. I have conversations with them. Most of them are lonely."
"The ice they're running is military-grade. That means expensive, not impenetrable."

story_hooks: Someone is impersonating Djeneba Park-Traore on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A Tier 4 executive offers Djeneba Park-Traore a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
Djeneba Park-Traore discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
narrative_function: Djeneba Park-Traore represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. His stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Pain editor — dampens pain signals, allows function through injuries that would incapacitate. Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario
Complete isolation — cut off from network, contacts, and purpose simultaneously

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (55.1%) with significant South Asian heritage (31.5%), complemented by Hispanic/Latin American (8.1%), East Asian (2.2%), Northern European (1.8%), and Eastern European (1.3%) ancestry. A true product of the Ubiquitous Diaspora — his phenotype reflects the dominant African and South Asian genetic signatures with subtle influences from the secondary ancestry groups.
physical_description.build: Stocky and solid with dense musculature — the kind of frame that suggests manual labor history and consistent gym work. Broad shoulders, thick forearms, no excess fat. Built for leverage and durability rather than speed.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and practical, faded tight on the sides, slightly longer on top. No styling — purely functional.
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle golden undertones from the South Asian component, sun-darkened from years in the GLMZ. The tone carries the richness of Sub-Saharan African genetics with a slight warmth that speaks to the South Asian heritage — neither purely cool nor purely warm, but a complex medium-dark brown that catches light differently depending on angle.
physical_description.complexion: Strong angular face reflecting African ancestry with prominent cheekbones and a powerful jaw. South Asian features contribute subtle definition to the nose bridge and brow structure. Weathered appearance — not from age alone but from accumulated stress and nocturnal living. A thin scar runs from left temple toward his ear. His expression defaults to neutral, watchful. Minimal grooming beyond functionality; beard stubble is constant.
distinguishing_marks: Thin, pale scar running from left temple diagonally toward the ear — approximately 8 cm, clean edge suggesting deliberate blade work
Tattoo on right forearm: circuit pattern in black ink, custom design suggesting early netrunner identity
Knuckles on both hands show old fracture marks and callusing — evidence of hand-to-hand work or equipment sabotage
Small burn mark on left wrist, about 2 cm diameter, pale and old — consistent with equipment malfunction
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome pain editor visible on the left side of his neck — a silver-gray subcutaneous interface plate approximately 4 cm × 6 cm with faint LED indicators beneath the skin surface. The augmentation is deliberately exposed, no effort to conceal it with clothing or synthetic skin. Gecko-grip fingertip implants visible as faint metallic sheen on finger pads under direct light; toe pads not visible under standard footwear.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion. Sits forward-leaning, weight on the balls of his feet even when stationary. Hands rest palms-down on surfaces or in lap, never crossed. Eyes constantly scan environments. Speaks quietly; people lean in to hear him. When moving through spaces, he favors edges and walls, remains aware of exits. Despite the nocturnal fatigue, his movements remain controlled and purposeful.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working professional with combat pragmatism. Standard: charcoal or black reinforced cargo pants with weighted pockets for equipment, steel-toed industrial boots (scuffed, well-maintained). Layered tops — usually a dark compression undershirt under a modified tactical vest or worn leather jacket without gang colors. The vest has custom pockets and cable routing for gear. No corpo logos or flashy augmentation showcases; everything is functional. Wears a worn leather wrist cuff on the left arm, probably concealing the pain editor or protective in a fight. His watch is old military-grade, not smart-linked. Small pouch belt carries lock picks, optical drives, and untraceable payment chips.
